title: Drone Advisory Committee for the 21st Century Act
official_summary:
Drone Advisory Committee for the 21st Century Act

This bill requires the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to take appropriate steps to encourage direct representation of county and tribal governments, as well as agriculture, forestry, rangeland sectors, and other rural interests on the Drone Advisory Committee.

The FAA must include public participation in the process of nominating individuals for membership on the committee.

summary.headline: A 2020 law asks the FAA to make sure county and tribal governments and rural industries have a voice on its drone advisory committee.
summary.what_it_does: The law requires the Federal Aviation Administration to take appropriate steps to encourage direct representation on the Drone Advisory Committee from county governments, tribal governments, and rural interests such as agriculture, forestry, and rangeland. It also requires the FAA to include public participation in the process of nominating people for membership on the committee.
